summary: Storage layout, opening and materialization are largely implementable; the biggest gap is that nothing declares a collection ordered or unordered, so membership-file order and stored bytes are undefined.

questions.text: Where is a collection declared ordered or unordered, and does materialization keep guest list order or sort membership by ID?
questions.reason: Decides stored membership bytes, diffs and possibly a new contract-identity field; ADR 0006 says both 'Membership preserves the guest list order' and 'For unordered collections the list is sorted by ID', while ADR 0005's CollectionDecl has no ordering flag.

questions.text: What happens to fact IDs or names that are empty or too long for a filename once ~hex escaped?
questions.reason: Escaping doubles length past the ~255-byte filename limit, and a later hashed fallback would move stored files; ADR 0006 only says 'Every other name is encoded as ~ followed by its complete lowercase UTF-8 hex'.

questions.text: Is the facts/<collection>/ directory named by the logical CollectionDecl name or the root field, and is it escaped like fact IDs?
questions.reason: Renaming either name may move every fact file; ADR 0006 says 'Each collection uses facts/<collection>/index.dhall' and 'ReadCollection takes the logical collection name', but ADR 0005 separates collection name from root field.

questions.text: Are root/recipes.dhall, root/recipes/ and root/model.dhall reserved locations, and which belong to the code snapshot versus the material LoadSourceAt excludes?
questions.reason: Decides what CodeSnapshot holds, what workspace creation copies and what may collide; ADR 0014 fixes 'root/recipes.dhall' and 'root/recipes/<recipe-id>/state.dhall' and ADR 0010 rejects them in target/, but ADR 0006's reserved list omits them and ADR 0028's model.dhall is unclassified.

questions.text: Which capability derives recipe state contracts (including closed recipes' flow signatures) when a root is opened, and with what SchemaMetadata?
questions.reason: ReadRootRecipes needs [(TypeRef, CheckedContract)] but runRootOpening has only SchemaInspection for named types; ADR 0014 says 'inspection derives both request and state types from that signature' without naming the operation.
